body:
Connect more of your apps to Search

You’ll be able to securely link and interact with your go-to services directly in AI Mode.

Senior Product Manager, Search

Engineering Lead, Search

You can now connect your favorite apps directly to AI Mode in Search to get more done. Simply link services like Instacart, Canva, or YouTube Music to build lists, design projects, or curate playlists without leaving your search results. Head over to AI Mode in Search today to start using these new integrations.

Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental.

"Connect more of your apps to Search" lets you link services directly to AI Mode.

Link your favorite apps to streamline daily tasks like grocery shopping or planning events.

Add ingredients to your Instacart cart or find design templates in Canva instantly.

Create custom YouTube Music playlists and start listening without leaving your search results.

Try these new integrations in AI Mode today to get more done with ease.

You can now link your favorite apps directly to AI in Search to get things done faster. For example, you can add groceries to your cart or save music playlists without leaving the search page. It makes planning projects or parties way easier. Just head over to AI in Search to try it out.

You can already connect some of your favorite services to the Gemini app , and now, to help you get even more done, we’re enabling you to directly connect your apps in Search.

Starting to roll out this week in the U.S., you can securely link and interact with some of your go-to services right in AI Mode . Here’s a look at how these integrations in Search can streamline your day:

Let’s say you’re planning a barbecue and using AI Mode for help with your grocery list. If you connect Instacart, you can add the ingredients straight into your Instacart shopping cart and check out with just a few taps on their app or website.

With Personal Intelligence and your connected apps, Search can give even more tailored responses.

Or, if you’re working on a project where you need some design concepts – like creating a flyer – you can ask Canva to show you some template options.

Want to build the perfect soundtrack for your next party? You can use AI Mode to curate a playlist, instantly save it to YouTube Music and press play to start the celebration.

Head over to AI Mode in Search to try the new connected apps today. We're working with a range of partners and look forward to launching with more apps soon.
